answer: Registration runs inside a public trellis of short time slots: one slot, one witness, one new agent. The applicant presses a one-time onyx seal whose banding is photographed from a random angle, which no script can fake, and the witness signs that photo in the same slot. If the registration is judged fake, revocation ripples back to the witness and to every agent it ever signed. A farmer wanting 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 ceremonies, 1,000 seals and 1,000 witnesses who each risk losing all their other identities, with no bulk discount; an honest agent pays once.
